title: MCP servers
summary: Give every agent extra tools by adding MCP servers. Approve MCP servers, in each agent's tab, decides which agents get them. For agents with no tools of their own, the app runs the tool calls.
usage: Open Settings › MCP and add a server with the form, or paste a configuration (mcpServers JSON, a claude mcp add line or an npx command). In a chat, type /mcp followed by a configuration or a description: an agent drafts it, and nothing is saved until you review it and click Save settings. Four servers come ready (sequential-thinking, fetch, git and memory) and can be turned off, edited or removed; fetch and git need uv installed. Changes apply only when you click Save settings. An organization's servers show under MCP in its environment and win over yours with the same name in its chats. Then turn on Approve MCP servers in the Settings tab of each agent that should use them (it starts off). Organizations can block it per agent, and Planning mode never uses the servers.
